bridge_explain:
For people who use scheduled actions in the Gemini app.

1. Turn it on and sign in with Google. Twice a day ForgeQuest writes your training summary to a "ForgeQuest data" Doc in your Drive.
2. Tap Copy prompt and paste it into a new scheduled action in the Gemini app.
3. Gemini writes its advice to "ForgeQuest from Gemini", and it shows on Home.

The app only sees those two Docs.

just_log_subtitle: Only track your training: no streaks, levels, badges or readiness.
key_dialog_body: Get a free key from Google AI Studio, then paste it here. It stays encrypted on this phone.
key_dialog_privacy: Meal photos and training data go to Google Gemini under this key. Free keys let Google use them for training models.
lib_delete_body: Only possible when no workout or plan uses it. Otherwise merge it into another exercise so your history stays intact.
lib_none_custom: Nothing custom yet. Exercises you create in a workout or the plan editor, and ones the coach invents, show up here.
lib_still_used: {1} is still used. Merge it into another exercise instead.
live_circuit_hint: One set of each, then repeat. Long-press a set to add a note.
live_discard_body: Logged sets from this workout will be deleted.

live_finish_unticked_body.one: Only ticked sets are saved. The {1} you didn't tick is dropped.
live_finish_unticked_body.other: Only ticked sets are saved. The {1} you didn't tick are dropped.

live_note_hint: Felt easy, add weight next time
live_reminder_body: At 18:00 on planned days, only if you haven't trained yet. Change it in Profile → Training.
live_reminder_title: Want a nudge on training days?
live_tick_all_finish: I did them all: tick & finish

map_cd_all_fresh: Muscle recovery map. All muscles fresh.
meals_doc_placeholder: ForgeQuest meals from Gemini. The ForgeQuest Food Gem adds one block per meal below this line, and the ForgeQuest app reads them. Do not edit by hand.
meals_hint: In Gemini, share the reply from your "ForgeQuest Food" Gem to ForgeQuest. New meals wait on the Food tab to confirm.
meals_inbox_hint: Tap a meal to check it and log it.
meals_paste_wrong: Copy the Gem's whole answer first, then tap Paste.
meals_share_wrong: That doesn't look like a ForgeQuest meal.

muscle_none: Nothing for your equipment yet. Switch to All equipment to see the rest.

notes_dialog_body: One fact per note, e.g. "Left knee hurts in deep squats" or "Only have a pull-up bar and rings".
notif_next_set: Next set when the timer ends

notif_reminder_body.one: {1} exercise on the plan. Tap to start.
notif_reminder_body.other: {1} exercises on the plan. Tap to start.

onb_ai_body: The meal scanner and coach run on Google Gemini. A personal key is free and takes about a minute.
onb_ai_step1: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
onb_ai_step2: Tap "Create API key", then copy it.
onb_body_body: We use these to work out your daily calories and protein.
onb_body_needed: Add your height and age to continue
onb_body_type: Body type (sets calories and the muscle map)
onb_built_body: Training days a week: {1}, picked to fit your equipment. Fine-tune it later in Plan.
onb_days_hint: This is your weekly streak target. You can change it any time in Profile.
onb_days_title: How many days a week can you train?
onb_equipment_hint: Pick what you have on most days. You can tick more later in Profile → Training.
onb_groq_hint: Want even faster chat? Add a free Groq key later in Profile.
onb_key_works: Key works. AI features are ready.
onb_plan_body: You can edit it, ask the coach to change it, or import your own later.
onb_privacy: Your key stays encrypted on this phone. Meal photos and your training data are sent to Google Gemini under it; free keys let Google use them to improve its models.
onb_start_empty_desc: No plan yet. Add your own exercises day by day.
onb_welcome_body: Train, eat well and watch yourself level up. First, what should we call you?
pace_blocked: Standard pace selected to protect muscle and healthy growth.
paste_gemini_done: Gemini's reply is in your coach.
paste_gemini_none: No ForgeQuest reply found. Copy Gemini's whole reply first.
pb_empty: We couldn't fit a plan to those answers. Try more days, more minutes or more gear.
pb_entry_info: Answer a few questions, get a plan
pb_progression: Progression: when you hit the top of the range on every set, add load or reps. Every 4th week, halve the sets.
pb_quick_hint: Four quick answers. You can change anything afterwards.
pb_schedule_hint: Tap a day to add it. Tap it again to set its minutes.
pb_why_equipment: Some exercises need gear you didn't pick.
pb_why_focus: Extra sets for your focus muscles.
pb_why_hold: Used holds where an exercise wasn't possible.
pb_why_injury: Left out exercises that could aggravate your injury.
pb_why_tier: Exercises matched to your push-up and pull-up numbers.
plan_add_weight_hint: For a plate on your back or a weighted vest.
plan_circuit_hint: Done round by round with the other circuit exercises in "{1}"
plan_delete_body: The schedule is removed. Workouts you did under it stay in your history.
plan_docs_info: Loads a plan from the "ForgeQuest plan" Google Doc in your Drive, for example one written by your Gemini automation. Opens Profile, where Google Drive is connected.
plan_gemini_info: Copy the template, ask Gemini, paste the plan back
plan_move_body: Pick the day to swap with. Whatever is on that day moves here.
plan_paste_hint: From notes, a message or a Google Doc. AI turns it into your schedule.
plan_previous_info: Switch back any time; history is kept
plan_previous_tap: Tap one to make it your plan again.
plan_ready_made_info: Plans that come with the app, from beginner to advanced. Picking one replaces your current plan; the old one stays under Previous plans.
plan_replaces: This replaces your current plan. Your workout history stays.
profile_about_you_hint: Sets your calorie suggestion and the body on the muscle map
profile_body_not_set: Not set yet. Tap + to set yours.
profile_bodyfat_hint: Leave at 0 unless you have a DEXA or caliper reading. Smart scales can be off by 5 to 8 points.
profile_carbs_suggested: Suggested {1} g: calories left after protein and a {2}% fat share

profile_credits_data: Food data: Open Food Facts (ODbL), Saudi Food and Drug Authority, USDA.
profile_floor_hint: The lowest target the app allows for you is {1} kcal.
profile_hand_hint: Helps portion estimates when your hand is in the photo
profile_health_hint: Off · turn on to get recovery, sleep and strain from your Fitbit through Health Connect
profile_health_on: Connected · recovery, sleep and strain on Home
profile_key_connected: Connected · runs the coach, meal scans and plans
profile_key_not_set: Not set · coach, meal scan and plans are off
profile_key_saved: Key saved. AI features are on.
profile_key_saved_offline: Saved. Couldn't check it while offline.
profile_lock_off: Ask for your fingerprint, face or PIN when the app opens.
profile_lock_on: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN when you open the app.
profile_lock_unavailable: Set up a screen lock or fingerprint on this phone first.
profile_memory_empty: Tell the coach about injuries, equipment or preferences and it keeps them here.
profile_memory_hint: Used in every conversation. Tap a line to remove it.
profile_reminder_off: Off. A nudge on planned days if nothing is logged yet.
profile_reminder_on: On planned days at {1}, only if nothing is logged yet.
profile_setup_body: Paste a free Gemini key. Takes about a minute.
profile_setup_title: Turn on the coach and meal scanning
profile_streak_explain: Your weekly streak counts weeks where you reach this number.
profile_suggested_v2: Suggested {1} kcal from your weight, height, age, normal day ({3}) and {2} training days a week
profile_vibration_hint: Ticks on steppers, a thud when a set is done
profile_xp_how: XP: {1} a workout, {2} a set, {3} a new record, {4} a badge. Your rank letter rises from E to S as you level up.
profile_your_data_hint: Save a file to keep, or bring everything to a new phone. Photos and your AI key stay out of it.
progress_empty_body: Finish a workout and this page fills in with your trends, records and consistency.
progress_empty_title: Your charts start after your first workout
progress_need_more: Two workouts of {1} and the line appears.
progress_recovery_hint: From your Fitbit, with the 7-day average
progress_strength_hint: Best set per workout (weighted exercises: estimated one-rep max) · gold dots are records · dashed line is your best
progress_weight_hint: Daily entries with a 7-day average line · drag to read
ready_debt: Includes {1} of sleep debt from recent short nights.
ready_failed_body: Couldn't read your Fitbit data this time.
ready_gave_up: Still nothing after 5 minutes. In the Fitbit app, check that sleep is shared with Health Connect, then tap refresh.
ready_no_data: No Fitbit data for last night yet. Wear it to bed and your recovery shows up here in the morning.
ready_no_stages: This night has no stage detail.
ready_no_strain_yet: No strain recorded yet today. It builds up from your heart rate as you move and train.
ready_reconnect_body: Fitbit access was turned off in Health Connect. Reconnect to see your readiness.
ready_recovery_explain: Compared with your last 60 days, led by last night's HRV. Green 67+, yellow 51–66, red below. Normal for you is about 75%.
ready_refresh_failed: Couldn't read Health Connect just now. These are the last numbers.
ready_sleep_explain: Sleep performance is the sleep you got against what you needed. Need starts at 8 hours and grows after hard days.
ready_sleep_only: No heart data from your watch yet, so recovery is based on your sleep alone.
ready_sleep_sentence: {1}% of the {2} you needed. You spent {3} in bed, sleep efficiency {4}%.
ready_strain_explain: Heart minutes above resting count, harder ones more. Light under 10, moderate 10–13, high 14–17, all out 18+ (scale 0–21).
ready_target_sentence: Today's target is {1}–{2}, set by your recovery.
ready_waiting: Still no new sleep from Fitbit. It can take a few minutes after syncing, so the app checks again every minute.
ready_yesterday: Yesterday's score: last night's sleep hasn't reached the app yet. Sync Fitbit, then tap refresh.
rest_exact_body: Allow alarms for ForgeQuest so the rest-over alert arrives on time when the screen is off. Without it, the alert can be a little late.
rest_exact_title: Get the rest alert on time
restore_body: Everything on this phone is replaced. A copy is kept: undo it in Profile → Backup and sync → Undo last restore.
restore_src_copy: the copy saved before your last restore
rx_hold_ceiling: ready for a harder version or added weight
rx_why_hard: A set felt hard last time. Same numbers today.
rx_why_load_up: You hit every set last time. Heavier today.
rx_why_low_readiness: Recovery is low today. Same numbers as last time.
rx_why_missed: Same numbers today. Finish every set and next time goes up.
rx_why_more_reps: Last time went well. One more rep today.
rx_why_more_time: You held every set last time. Hold a little longer today.
rx_why_once_more: Same weight. Hit it once more and the load goes up.
rx_why_pain: A set hurt last time. Lighter today.
scan_camera_ask: Allow the camera to scan meals, or pick a photo from your gallery.
scan_camera_denied: Camera access was turned off for ForgeQuest. Turn it on in the app's settings, or pick a photo from your gallery.

scan_err_generic: Something went wrong reading that meal. Try again.
scan_err_no_food: No food found in that photo. Try again with the plate in the middle of the frame.
scan_err_slow: The in-app scan is taking too long. Ask your AI app instead, or try again.
scan_err_unreadable: Couldn't read the meal from that photo. Try again with the plate fully in frame.
scan_frame_hint: Fit the whole plate in frame. A hand or fork beside it helps with portions.
scan_outside_body: The prompt is on your clipboard too. Copy the answer in the AI app, then come back here and it fills in by itself.
scan_outside_wrong_format: The copied text isn't a meal estimate in the app's format. Copy the AI's whole answer, then come back.
scan_save_hint: Log it again later with one tap
scan_tap_name: Tap the name to change it
score_first_ever: First one done. That's the hardest part.
settings_ai_gemini_body: Free, and it gives the best results. Copy a prompt, ask Gemini in its own app, then paste its reply here.
settings_ai_key_body: The free API is basic. It handles quick meal estimates and chat, but the Gemini app does more.
skill_copied: Skill copied. Paste it into the instructions of a Gem in the Gemini app.
stepper_tap_to_type: Tap the number to type it
steps_using: Using your watch: about {1} steps a day

streak_next_week.other: next week: {1} workouts keep it going

target_nudge_body.other: You've trained {1} times a week lately. Make {1} your weekly target?

today_no_plan_hint: Pick a starter plan, build your own, or ask the coach.
today_resume_hint: Pick up where you left off
tour_1_b: ForgeQuest keeps you coming back by pacing you: it pushes on good days and backs off on tired ones.
tour_2_b: Your streak counts weeks you hit your workout target, not every single day. Rest days never break it.
tour_3_b: Start from a ready plan, or let Gemini turn a YouTube programme into one (Workouts → Change plan). Log sets with a rest timer, and new records are spotted for you.
tour_4_b: Snap a photo of your meal and AI estimates protein and calories, carbs too if you want them. The rings on Home fill as you eat.
tour_5_b: Chat any time. It remembers your injuries and equipment, writes a weekly check-in, and can rebuild your plan.
tour_6_b: Optional: connect a Fitbit through Health Connect for daily recovery, sleep and strain, and know when to push or ease off.
tour_7_b: Earn XP, climb ranks, unlock badges, and watch your progress and muscle recovery over time.
tour_replay_hint: A quick look at what ForgeQuest can do
update_allow: Allow ForgeQuest to install updates, then tap Update again.
update_download_failed: The download didn't finish. Check your connection and tap Update again.
update_failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
update_hint: Current version: v{1} · Tap to check for updates
update_not_ready: This update is still being published. Try again in a few minutes.
update_notes_after: You'll see what's new after it installs.
welcome_back_body: Good to see you again. Ease in with one set fewer per exercise today?
workouts_rest_hint: Recovery is when muscles grow. Take it easy, stretch, walk.
